name: Prince Zel
source:
(Based on Rapunzel from "Rapunzel")

Nobody has seen Prince Zel of Forest Kingdom ever since he was abducted by an evil witch years ago. Despite the royal family's best efforts, Prince Zel was never found. The loss of such a sincerely sweet and kind - albeit rather naive - prince shook the kingdom to the core, dealing a devastating blow to the rule of the sovereign that they never truly recovered from.
Rumors claim that, while he's alive, he's trapped in a tower in the middle of a dangerous forest, guarded day and night by a ferocious dragon. Little is known about the now grown Prince Zel, but given how timid he was in his youth, it is likely that he has only become even shier and more fearful after everything he must have been through.
